A real interpreter. A very small subset of Rust.

    


    
Built with JavaScript. Rust has not approved this message.

  

  
A little Rust. A lot of audacity.
This is a JavaScript interpreter for a small Rust-like language. Your code runs locally in a dedicated browser worker.
What works
  • fn, let, mut, numbers, booleans, strings and arithmetic.
  • println!, String::from, .clone() and common string methods.
  • if / else, bounded loops, functions and structs.
  • Some / None, Ok / Err and match.
  • Moves and shared or mutable references, checked at runtime.
The fine print
Borrow lifetimes follow lexical scopes. Type annotations are accepted but this is not a Rust type checker. No crates, traits, lifetimes, async, threads or native compilation. Execution has step, output and time limits.
Unsafe mode bypasses ownership and borrow checks. It does not provide Rust's unsafe semantics or actual unsafe memory access.
